item.tib: dus sum mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan kun bzang nam mkha'i rgyal po'i rgyud las myang grol dam rdzas chen po'i bum sgrub u dum wa ra
item.coloph: de ltar bum sgrab u dum wa ra 'di ni mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas gter du sbas phyi rabs skal ldan gshen dang 'phrad par shog rgya rgya rgya/ bdag 'dra kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis pho nya rta'i lor kong yul yongs rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas drangs ste (te)/ slar smin grol khrod du lcags bya lor shog ser bod yig tu bshos (bshus) pa dge zhing bkra shis//
